statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0406 is a use-after-free when changing a multithreaded context with an unfinished frame in zstd-safe, fixed in zstd-safe 7.4.0. Milvus includes zstd-safe 6.0.6 and 7.0.0 through the zstd 0.12 and 0.13 crates used by its Tantivy text-index binding. The binding pins zstd-sys to exactly 2.0.9 (zstd 1.5.5, the zstd release the Milvus C++ core links), zstd-safe 7.4.0 requires zstd-sys 2.0.17 or later, and the zstd 0.12 line used by one Tantivy fork cannot take zstd-safe 7 at all, so the fix is an upstream dependency change under evaluation. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0406.html
